name: spotlight
title: Spotlight Background
description: A near-black backdrop with a faint square grid and one soft diagonal beam of light that fades in and widens over the text below it. It is there to pull the eye to a single block of copy.
use: A dark page needs to hint at a focal line of copy without adding a heavy or looping animation.
avoid: You need the glow to track the cursor, or a light theme: it is fixed white on black.
a11y: The decorative SVG is not marked aria-hidden and the load sweep ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage crossed by a faint square grid. A wide, soft white cone of light enters from the top-left and falls diagonally across the middle, brightest and broadest over the centred white headline and the small grey paragraph under it.
behaves: On load an oversized blurred ellipse fades in and slides down-left for about two seconds, growing into the beam, then holds still. It does not follow the pointer; the sweep happens once.
customise: Only className and fill are exposed. Size, position, opacity and the one-shot sweep live in the source and its inline keyframes.
weight: light: One static SVG ellipse under a blur filter and a single CSS fade on load.
